bayts.text: Praise of the Prophet, the Select One, is a provision toward the House of the God of mankind, Giver of favours.
Love of the Prophet, for the God Who fashioned him, is a provision toward Medina the Radiant.
Muḥammad – may Allah bless him, granting him peace –: his loftiness has appeared to us.
Muḥammad is a singular that surpasses the dual, and has surpassed the plural; and (his) gifts enrich.
The degree of the Chosen One, beloved of the Sender: by it is the rising above the degrees of the messengers.
Every prophet and messenger follows (in time) the creation of my means of approach: he is the one followed.
Our Aḥmad, the Māḥī (the Effacer), erased what afflicted, and drove the evildoer toward others than us.
To Aḥmad, the Chosen One, (belongs) what has not been and never shall be for any contingent being.
His beauty captivates the heart of whoever sees him, and his way frees from falsehood.
He extended to us faith and Islam, and the finest of excellence (iḥsān): we shall not be blamed.
My writing gladdens him every year, and other commendable services.
It is not hidden that praise and love are a provision toward his Garden (the Rawḍa) and toward the House, and a favour.
